digest.component_or_area: backend neutrality test / Jira adapter architecture
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at package root to allow Data Center and Cloud adapters to share it without violating the J7 sibling-adapter seal in both directions
The sweep exemption in test_backend_neutrality.py was documented as temporary relocation debt but represents a permanent architectural cost
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would create a forbidden Data Center-to-Cloud adapter import
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because core importers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) cannot import that layer
The exemption comment and test diagnostics must be rewritten to explain the durable J7 seal rationale rather than treat it as follow-up work
